title: Google Website Translator
text:
## Google Website Translator
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000044521

## Overview
Growing and managing an international directory or membership website can be challenging… especially if the members and users speak different languages.
The Google Website Translator add-on will add a drop-down menu to the website, allowing users to select their language. Once selected, Google Translate will be used to translate the front-end of the website to the user’s selected language.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Google Website Translator Add-On

## Enabling the Add-On
1. Settings » Design Settings » General » Header Design:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12094237130/original/EwOHRdMc86WOblc0-P7rnGcaDKG-N2VyCg.png?1623969392 | alt: ]
This tool will appear in the header:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12083729739/original/uJcLBWS5TvlMZ1zYtmjrplolwHaFVlywcw.png?1602852686 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12083729762/original/Xg0pOmLwotNYt_P8WjNVJ_mZj2N4e-2nUA.png?1602852710 | alt: ]
To revert the site back to the original language, use the " Show Original " button that appears at the top of the web page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12083729823/original/mJIxGMqAun99mUXdoA5zWsk3Z2_4M9YcJQ.png?1602852778 | alt: ]
** Google Translate won't show the default website language as an option in the drop-down because technically, there is no need to translate it since that's the main language of the website. **

## Additional Functionality
The admin will be able to change the wording that displays instead of the usual "Select Language" by editing the text label select_language_option_google_translate :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095063049/original/v9Gia3zfaSWVFdzQOfO8OFAINI9BP2Evhw.png?1625513490 | alt: ]
By default it will be blank making the "Select Language" appear, once the new text is added it will replace it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095063208/original/4vxxP4UxQFTGYFpW1ivHshYn1QNm_VIwVA.png?1625513967 | alt: ]
With this add-on it is also possible to limit the languages available that can be translated. To do this, follow the steps below.
1. Go to Settings » Advanced Settings, search for:
» translate_languages
Edit the languages here -
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12095130784/original/5RnuOV9xtKTfuZTqPk-HkaVmkFxtEdiWYA.png?1625622206 | alt: ]
See the list of the languages using the link below:
https://cloud.google.com/translate/docs/languages
